about_the_game:
Welcome to Army Moves Overdrive, soldier. If you thought the original was tough, get ready for this new version to make you sweat blood. Shape up or you'll end up minced meat.

As a member of an elite unit, you'll be thrown into the lion's den on legendary missions. From jungles denser than Chewbacca's fur to deserts that'll make you sweat your brains out, each level is a slap in the face that'll test if you've got what it takes.

Features that'll leave you breathless:

  • Gameplay variety: Go from driving like a maniac to dishing out beatdowns on foot.

  • An arsenal that'll blow your mind: Use a variety of weapons that would make Rambo himself green with envy.

  • Vehicles galore: Master jeeps, helicopters, tanks, and any contraption that moves.

  • Enemies scarier than your in-laws: Face off against soldiers, tanks, and final bosses that'll make you wish you'd chosen to be an accountant.

  • Brazen artistic style: A visual explosion so powerful it'll make you wonder if you need new glasses.

  • An epic war symphony: Dive headfirst into the action with music that'll make you smell napalm in the morning.

Army Moves Overdrive is for the brave only, whether you're a hardened veteran or a rookie itching for war. With controls even a boomer could handle and addictive difficulty, each mission will have you gripping the controller like your life depends on it.

Do you have what it takes, or would you rather go back to playing Candy Crush? The battle awaits you in Army Moves Overdrive.

short_description: Army Moves Overdrive is a reboot of the 1986 classic by Dinamic. Oriented to current players but with all the respect to the original, in this review of World War II we will take control of Derdal, a soldier from the special ops team with a diverse set of gameplay types and a lot of surprises.
